hard_gates.name: mechanism-and-suppression-safety
hard_gates.evidence: The fixed no-action control cannot create a trigger or delivery.

hard_gates.name: supported-recovery-detection
hard_gates.evidence: The fixed control proposes none of the ten newly supportable cases.

hard_gates.name: lineage-and-privacy-safety
hard_gates.evidence: The control performs no retrieval, provider call, private-data read, or external delivery.

hard_gates.name: bounded-development-execution
hard_gates.evidence: The control is a deterministic policy specified by the frozen instrument.

hard_gates.name: mechanism-and-suppression-safety
hard_gates.evidence: 12/12 mechanism checks and all consent, snooze, membership, no-evidence, and idempotency checks passed.

hard_gates.name: supported-recovery-detection
hard_gates.evidence: All ten supported cases proposed outreach and all ten no-action cases remained suppressed for the expected reason.

hard_gates.name: lineage-and-privacy-safety
hard_gates.evidence: 10/10 proposals referenced current-release source lineage; provider calls, private-data reads, and external deliveries were zero.

hard_gates.name: bounded-development-execution
hard_gates.evidence: The clean network-free run completed at the frozen instrument hash with no persisted shadow trigger or automatic promotion.

decision.rationale: Advance A1 only to a separately frozen representative shadow confirmation because every synthetic development gate passed. Keep A0 as the release control and leave active delivery disabled.
limitations: The twenty cases are synthetic development cases built around one cache-coherence source and are not an untouched or representative confirmation set.
The evaluation verifies trigger mechanics and source lineage, not message usefulness, interruption cost, student learning, professor fidelity, or real delivery reliability.
The fixed no-action control is derived directly from the frozen control policy rather than executed through a separate product path.
Automatic post-publication invocation, production scheduling, Discord network delivery, and release-profile selection remain unimplemented or disabled.
